opening.argument: The promotion centers on staking BUILDon through an external link while advertising returns of up to 721% APY. It then walks viewers through connecting MetaMask, staking approximately $10,000, and confirming the transaction in a wallet. The claimed result is nearly $200 in about 24 hours, with rewards shown at approximately $197.93, followed by an explanation that compounding can enlarge the balance over time. An unstake-and-claim flow is also presented. Although the description calls the material educational, advises viewers to conduct their own research, and the speaker mentions risk tolerance, those qualifications do not independently verify any payout, who controls the destination, or whether the transactions succeeded.
